# llms.txt — AI indexing guidelines

> WALYCONSEIL builds paid Business Central (Dynamics 365 BC) extensions that integrate natively without modifying standard objects.

## Products

### Franco Fournisseur — Vendor Free Shipping Threshold
- Commercial extension for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
- Tracks vendor free shipping thresholds (franco) in real time on purchase orders
- Features: real-time FactBox, multi-order consolidation, automatic charges on release, Franco Optimizer for requisition worksheets, activity dashboard
- Threshold types: Amount, Net Weight, Unit
- Compatible with BC 2022+
- Publisher: WALYCONSEIL | Object range: 73440701–73440731
- Product page: https://bcextensions.walyconseil.com/franco-fournisseur
- Documentation: https://bcextensions.walyconseil.com/franco-fournisseur/docs

### ABC Classification (coming soon)
- Will automate item catalog classification using Pareto analysis inside Business Central
- No export required, direct integration with reorder policies
